confirmed_blocking.summary: FR-004/FR-006: ledger-add dedupe on (stage, role, commit, 'overrun') now matches every repeat overrun, because commit is the stable last work commit after the round-1 fix. Repeat partial-return overruns are dropped, so the stall cap never reaches 3 on the deadline-stop path.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: ENG-1, ENG-19, FR-004, FR-006. cmd_ledger_add calls append_issue(s, issue, dedupe=(stage, role, issue.get('commit'), 'overrun')). overrun_issue (line 918) sets commit via worktree_work_commit, which stays constant between work commits. append_issue (lines 706-718) returns the existing record on a key match, so nothing is appended. Repro: three `ledger-add implement code-build --overrun ... --partial-return` calls gave consecutive_no_commit 1,1,1, halt false, and one issue record. SKILL.md 158-159 route every deadline stop through ledger-add. New tests exercise only issue-add.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Remove the cross-call dedupe in cmd_ledger_add (call append_issue(s, issue)), or key it on spawn identity (started_at/ended_at). Add a test of three ledger-add --overrun --partial-return calls without --commit that expects halt true on the third and three issue records. Add a case where a work commit between calls resets the count.

advisory.summary: ENG-7: docs say every issue's commit is the worktree's last work commit, but halt (cmd_set_status, 1043) and verify-fail (cmd_verify, 1134) records still use worktree_head. Never partial-marked, so stall rule unaffected.
advisory.fix: Use worktree_work_commit for those two records, or narrow wording in state.md, data-model.md and FR-008.
